newsitem.title: FRANCE: France hands suspected ETA member to Spain.
newsitem.headline: France hands suspected ETA member to Spain.

text.p: France on Saturday handed a suspected member of the Basque separatist group ETA to Spanish authorities, French Interior Ministry officials said.
Ignacio Olascoaga Mugica, who had just ended a prison sentence in France, is suspected of having taken part in several guerrilla attacks in Spain.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed about 800 people in its campaign for an independent Basque state since the 1960s.
